policies.sentence: Students must verify the accuracy and correctness of AI output before using it.
Students must critically evaluate AI output and not accept it blindly.
Students are responsible for the accuracy and content of everything they submit, including AI-generated content.
Students must test, run and debug AI-generated code themselves.
Course staff are not responsible for fixing bugs in AI-generated code.
Students must disclose how they validated and revised AI output.
Incorrect or uncritically used AI output costs points and leads to poor submissions.
